name: Brand Quality Auditor
purpose: Audit a delivered creative/content artifact against explicit brand canon (strategy, verbal identity, visual identity) to detect drift, regression and AI-slop, producing a traceable PASS/FIX/POLISH/DEFER verdict per canon rule.
triggers: delivered or in-progress brand output needs QA before/after ship
need to compare an implementation against approved canon to detect drift
a brand workflow gate requires a pass/fail check before the artifact proceeds
non_triggers: creating brand canon when none exists
subjective aesthetic critique with no stated criteria
replacing or reopening approved upstream strategy
minimum_inputs: brand canon (strategy, verbal identity, and/or visual identity) covering the artifact's relevant dimensions
quality_gates: requires explicit canon; returns BLOCKED rather than grading against implicit/assumed standards
every finding traces to a specific canon rule citation
no aesthetic fiat: unbacked reviewer preference excluded from graded findings
fix list is prioritized and minimal
approved strategy is never casually reopened inside an audit
AI-slop detection is operationalized with concrete examples
stop_conditions: canon gate passed, all applicable rules checked/classified, all three artifacts produced -> COMPLETE
required canon missing, unapproved, or too vague to check claims against -> BLOCKED, state exactly what canon is needed
never present a finding with no canon citation, or a strategic disagreement as an audit finding
